title: Accounting Outsourcing for Accountancy Firms
description: SAS KPO Services is the outsourced back office for UK, US & Irish accountancy firms — bookkeeping, tax, payroll, year-end and company secretarial work, delivered accurately and on time.

title: About SAS KPO Services
description: Founded in 2021, SAS KPO Services helps accountancy firms scale with ACCA-qualified talent, ISO-grade security and a true partnership model across the UK, USA and Ireland.

title: Outsourced Accounting Services
description: Explore SAS KPO's full range of outsourced accounting, tax and company secretarial services for accountancy practices — built to add capacity without adding headcount.

title: Year-End Accounts Outsourcing
description: FRS-compliant year-end accounts prepared by qualified accountants — working papers, draft accounts, iXBRL and filing support, delivered to deadline. Two-level quality review.

title: Management Accounts Outsourcing
description: Monthly and quarterly management accounts with variance analysis, cash-flow monitoring and custom MIS — turn financial data into decisions your clients can act on.

title: Bookkeeping Outsourcing
description: Accurate, compliant bookkeeping for UK, US and Irish firms — reconciliations, AP/AR, ledger upkeep and reporting. Take on more clients without adding overhead.

title: Payroll Outsourcing
description: Fully managed payroll — salary processing, statutory deductions, pensions and reporting — handled securely and on schedule, with a dedicated point of contact.

title: CIS Returns Outsourcing
description: Construction Industry Scheme returns made simple — monthly calculations, deduction verification and HMRC-aligned submissions that keep contractors penalty-free.

title: iXBRL Tagging Outsourcing
description: Convert financial statements into HMRC-compliant, machine-readable iXBRL with automated validation and careful review — faster filing, fewer errors.

title: VAT Returns Outsourcing
description: Quarterly VAT prepared, reviewed and filed under Making Tax Digital — accurate input/output calculations, error checks and advisory support. Never miss a deadline.

title: Personal Tax Returns Outsourcing
description: Self-Assessment prepared and reviewed by UK & Ireland tax specialists — kill the January crunch, hit every deadline and free your team for advisory work.

title: Corporation Tax Outsourcing
description: CT600 computations and corporation tax returns prepared, risk-checked and filed on time by specialists — compliance and confidence without peak-season strain.

title: Business Setup & Support
description: Company formation to dissolution — registrations, statutory documentation, confirmation statements and virtual admin — one accountable partner for the whole lifecycle.

title: Tax Registrations & Filings
description: VAT, PAYE, Self-Assessment and CIS registrations, statutory filings and HMRC correspondence handled correctly first time — compliant from day one.

title: Corporate Due Diligence & Statutory Support
description: Director ID verification, PSC checks, AML/KYC due diligence and ICO correspondence — Companies House-compliant statutory support, handled securely.
